name: worktree-diff
description: A side pane showing what the current git worktree changed versus the branch it came from

autoOpen.title: Auto-open the Changes pane
autoOpen.description: worktree: when the session is in a linked git worktree; always: in any git repository; never: only with /wt-diff

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the open pane re-reads git to catch edits made outside Claude; 0 turns polling off

statusLine.title: Show totals under the prompt
statusLine.description: Shows `5 files +added −removed` at the end of the hint line under the prompt (the status line on other surfaces), even while the pane is closed

diffStyle.title: How an open diff is drawn
diffStyle.description: quiet: changed lines in green and red text, no background; engine: Claude Code's own diff view, with syntax colours and line numbers

diffView.title: Where a file's diff shows
diffView.description: side: the diff of the file under the cursor in a region of its own, beside the tree (w switches between them); inline: under its row, opened with enter

paneBackground.title: Pane background
paneBackground.description: transparent: the terminal's own background shows through the pane; theme: Claude Code's pane fill
